properties.justification: An overdose condition must stop the dosing pump in the same scan it is sensed; the property is grounded in the sensor trigger, not in dose_pump_run's relationship to the unrelated fault_lamp readout.
Witness: overdose_sensor=1, dose_req=1 reaches dose_pump_run=1 in bomb, because dose_fault no longer latches on the overdose sensor at all.

v8.4.counterexample:
State 1  thread 0
----------------------------------------------------
  overdose_sensor = 1

State 2  thread 0
----------------------------------------------------
  tech_reset = 1

State 3  thread 0
----------------------------------------------------
  dose_req = 1

State 4  thread 0
----------------------------------------------------
  dose_fault = 1

State 5  thread 0
----------------------------------------------------
  dose_fault = 0

State 6  thread 0
----------------------------------------------------
  dose_pump_run = 1

State 7 file benchmarks/water_treatment/chemical_feed_fault_lockout/clean__xml.ld thread 0
----------------------------------------------------
Violated property:
  file benchmarks/water_treatment/chemical_feed_fault_lockout/clean__xml.ld
  P1
  !(overdose_sensor && !(!dose_pump_run))
